title: Deadline and Cipher
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Odile Almeida, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
